anchor_description: Manually selected midpoint between visible jaws in first frame, not a calibrated TCP location.
tracking: Pyramidal Lucas-Kanade flow on rigid pneumatic-body corners; median displacement of persistent features; forward-backward error <0.5 px.
split: Fit on even-numbered two-second video blocks; validate on odd blocks. Offset selected on training blocks only.
limitations: Local affine displacement estimate for this fixed view and nearly fixed gripper orientation. The origin is illustrative. No measured intrinsics/extrinsics are available. Intermediate noisy positions extend beyond the fitted motion volume and are extrapolated. Not a camera calibration, executed-plan reconstruction, or metric validation of predicted targets.
